$comment: Hash of each frozen version's slice in the dump it was blessed from, excluding doc/description/examples (none of which reach the generated output), taken off the parsed dump before generation runs (see lib/dump-digest.mts). Generation fails if a frozen version's slice moves, because its files are skipped and the rest of the tree would be generated against a model they no longer hold. Run `yarn generate:api` and paste what it prints to seed a version. Record $source when you do.
$source: ghcr.io/truenas/middleware:master, middlewared 20260828160014~truenas+1 (digest sha256:cacb76b6fe3baf3f37f929eef8267f1f89653ae3aa536c9466217c97b37f049c, fetched 2026-08-28). Re-seeded together with a regeneration of v25.10.0-v25.10.5 from this same dump, so the hashes and the frozen files describe one model rather than two. The previous seed recorded a dump that already disagreed with the files on disk. That disagreement is no longer between the seed and the files, but it did not close: the event payload for app.query still describes AppEntry differently from the call side, and both shapes are now homed in v25_10_0 rather than one being inherited from it. See src/generated-known-gaps.spec.ts, which pins it. Note this dump is not a clean 25.10 snapshot: it is master describing historical versions, so the regenerated v25.10 directories carry master's backports into those slices as well as the --dump-api fix that describes objects which previously collapsed to Record. The virt.* namespace and pool.dataset.encryption_algorithm_choices are hand-restored after generation; no dump reproduces either, in any version.
